clips.name: idle_cruise
clips.note: Cruise hover (loop): ring centre 4.5 b, bob +-0.12 b over 80 t, a +-1.5 degree pitch wobble over 120 t and a +-1.1 roll wobble over 240 t, the arch tilted 35 and rocking +-20 over 80 t, the halo floating behind the bob, the pendulum swinging with the wobble (simulated). Spinners: halo 2.25, inner ring -4.5, brim 4.5, eye medallion 4.5, gear medallion -6, drill pods 11.25, plates 1.5 degrees per tick (exact whole symmetry steps in 240 t).

clips.name: glide
clips.note: Travel (loop, while the module glides the body in or out at 0.15-0.18 b/t): nose down 3 degrees, a quicker bob +-0.07 over 40 t, a +-1.5 degree roll sway, the pendulum trailing 3 degrees, the drill pods 0.05 b lower and swaying round the axis.

clips.name: entrance
clips.note: Dormant -> cruise (untargetable until risen): folded at ring centre 2.15 b (temporary off look), the clank jolt (16), a gold flare at the hub (20-29), the four pods drop and spin up (20-30), the halo and the inner ring rise out of the hole, the core drum grows on top and the ring lifts to 2.8 b with the plate and pendulum hanging under it, the dagger near the floor (30-50), the eye opens (60: call look/idle; the clip ends its temporary off look there), the arch turns from flat to its 35 degree tilt and the eye swings from up to the front (60-78), the rise 2.8 -> 4.5 b (64-94, eased) with the stack spreading as it leaves the floor, a small overshoot and settle (94-110). The module turns the body to the player (face/track) from risen.

clips.name: bomb_run
clips.note: C1 bombing run: turn to the player and nose down 16 degrees while rising to 4.8 b (0-10), the bomb ports glow (10-12: temporary charge look), the run 12-57 (the module glides the body at 0.55 b/t and drops the bombs at port_0..7; the pendulum trails the acceleration, a 3 degree roll sway), level out and back to 4.5 b (48-57). It chains into slam at 57 (the module plays slam on the same tick): the finisher column 57-70, plunge 70-74, slam 74, rise 74-94 on the combined clock.

clips.name: slam
clips.note: C2 slam (and the C1 finisher): the eye turns face down, the arch flat, the core sinks 0.35 b (0-4) and the gold column reaches the floor (4-8), the tell holds while the device lifts 0.25 b (8-13), the plunge to ring centre 2.1 b (13-17, ease in) with the stack compressed and the halo lagging, the slam (17: the module hits r 5), the bounce and sit (17-22), the rise back to 4.5 b (22-37). Temporary charge look 0-22.

clips.name: laser
clips.note: C3 lasers: the medallions drop from the ring-end docks to r 2.8 b, 2 b under the ring, faces turned down-out (0-4), the charge (4-22: temporary charge look, the medallions trembling), thin aim lines (20), the beams fire at 22 (48 degrees from straight down: floor spots on r 5.58 b at ring centre 4.5) with a width bloom 0.5 -> 1.0 b (22-25) and a recoil lift, then both medallions orbit the ring axis in opposite directions at exactly 5 degrees per tick for 133 t (manifest orbit: the eye medallion from the left toward the front, the gear from the right toward the front; the spots meet in front 18 t after fire, then every 36 t, back and front), the width back to 0.5 (148-155), the beams off (155-157), the medallions rise back into the docks while finishing their second turn (155-165).

orbit.note: azimuths in degrees round the ring axis from the device front toward its left (+x): eye = 90 - 5 (t - from), gear = -90 + 5 (t - from)

clips.name: missiles
clips.note: C4 missiles: the spikes tip up 10 degrees and tremble while their tips flare (0-8: the module's fx at spike_tip_l / r), the eye turns up, the arch lies flat and the gold vent column rises 6 b from the core, lifting the halo 0.4 b (8-12), held and flickering (12-23), ten launches 23-37 from vent_l / vent_r (the module's missiles) with a 0.08 b recoil sag and pitch shudder, the column drops away (38-41), everything back to cruise by 60. Temporary charge look 0-42.

clips.name: coreup
clips.note: C5 ground impact: the spark (0; module fx at core), the arch stands upright and the eye faces out (1-4), the gold flash (5-8: core_glow 0 -> 1.6 -> 1.1), the lift (6-15, ease out): the exposed gold sphere rises 2.8 b over the ring, the device rises to 5.0 b and rolls 10 degrees, the spikes roll to vertical, the medallions slide to the ring ends facing out and the iris spike flips up (three eyes in a row), hold (15-28), the up-beam (28-40: gold column up 6 b), the core drops back to +0.6 b in 3 t and the column goes down to the floor (41-44), the blast (48: the module hits; a recoil jolt), hold (49-81), the return: the core sinks into the hole, the arch swings back, the iris spike flips down, spikes and medallions re-dock, a roll rock (81-130).

clips.name: tower_throw
clips.note: C6 rock throw: the dip toward the player to ring centre 2.9 b, nose down 24 and rolled 8 (0-12, the stack compressed), the vent: the gold column up 4.5 b and the medallions flung up and out to +-5.5 b (12-20), the rise and level while the tower telescopes up (20-38: column, tiers +1.35 / +2.0, the halo x1.7 at +3.2, the inner ring at +2.5, the end spikes up 45, the iris spike up, the medallions docking on the column top by 36, the Ousia flame), the flame band charge (38-55: the tiers counter-rotate at 4.5 degrees per tick, the device trembles), eight bursts 55..97 every 6 t (manifest bursts: a dip and a tier pulse each), five throws 100..132 every 8 t (manifest throws: a roll twitch each), the revert: the tower folds back with a roll wobble -18 -> 9 -> 0 (140-155). Temporary charge look 10-142.

clips.name: warp_out
clips.note: Warp out: the halo flips upright and spins like a wheel while the device pitches nose up 35 degrees, showing its underside (0-11), the rig scales to 0 in 1 t (11-12; the module's warp flash at hide 12) and stays hidden to the end; it holds hidden until the module plays warp_in_field (34). Moving the body is invisible from 12 (the module moves it at out 13).

clips.name: warp_in_field
clips.note: Warp in at the arena centre: a white-gold flash and vis 0 -> 1 (0-2) at ring centre 5.8 b, then the unfold like a spring (1-17): the core drops out of the hole and hangs, the plates and pendulum spread, the pods move out to core level, the medallions slide out beside the core, the arch starts its gyroscope turn, overshooting at 12 and settling at 17; the gold link beams and the violet column appear (17-21); settle (21-40). Call crack/0 + look/field at unfold (the violet halos and the bubble).

clips.name: wave
clips.note: 「인력 충격파」 one wave: the charge sphere (core_glow charge) grows round the core to 1.5 in four pulses (0-23), the 1 t gold beam from the core to the floor (beam 23), the burst (24 = impact: the module starts the front at 0.55 b/t), a 0.16 b recoil lift and settle (24-40).

clips.name: wave_long
clips.note: The long 「인력 충격파」 (the opening third wave): a 40 t charge in four pulses (0-39), the beam (39), the burst (impact 40), settle (40-56).

clips.name: wave_drop
clips.note: The closing third wave with the drop (v2 B3): the charge sinks the device 0.5 b (0-39), the beam (39) and the burst (impact 40), then the drop -2.9 b in 4 t onto the floor with the stack compressed (ring centre 2.4 b, the core resting on the floor; 40-44), grounded 19 t, the lift-off flash (63) and the rise (63-83).

clips.name: field_idle
clips.note: Field hover (loop): ring centre 5.8 b, bob +-0.1 b over 120 t, a slow +-1 degree wobble, the core hanging with the arch turning round it like a gyroscope (3 degrees per tick), the medallions bobbing beside it on pulsing link beams, the four pods orbiting at core level (1.5 degrees per tick), the violet column and the Ousia flame.

clips.name: field_erupt
clips.note: F1 감소 영역 activation (22 t, the tell of the whole pattern): the gyroscope arch slows and locks facing the front, the eye looks out and the device rises 0.15 b (0-12), the medallions slide out to r 4.2 b on brightening link beams and the core flashes gold (12-22; erupt: the module starts the eruption events). Then it loops in field_active until the module plays another clip.

clips.name: field_active
clips.note: The activated field hover (loop, after field_erupt): the arch locked facing the front, the eye out, the medallions at r 4.2 b on bright pulsing link beams, a slower bob, the pods orbiting. Play field_idle (or any clip) when the pattern is over.

clips.name: frock
clips.note: F2 rock throw in the field form (the module plays it for F2): the arch locks, the gold vent column up 4 b with a roll (0-12), back to the violet column (12-18), the flame band (8-25: module fx, the device trembles), eight bursts 25..67 every 6 t (manifest bursts: a dip each), five throws 65..97 every 8 t (manifest throws: a roll twitch each), end 100, back to the field hover (100-110).

clips.name: field_end
clips.note: Unbroken field end (pack-up): the lift-off flash (0-6) and the rise to 6.3 b (2-20) while the link beams and the violet column go out and the gyroscope stops, the spikes turn spike-down in their docks (2-20), the lances: they move out to 5.6 b with the medallions in their X frames (20-28), then turn horizontal pointing outward (32-40: the deployed form), the pack-up roll 24 -> -15 -> 8 degrees while the core swings up from under the ring to the top (the arch turns 180 degrees over; 40-55), the lances dock as the rim spikes and the pods tuck (50-62), settle to 4.5 b (55-70). Call look/idle at dock (58).

clips.name: break
clips.note: 역장 붕괴 (the 20th hit; the module calls crack/4 at burst): the bubble flares with the core (0-5), bursts (5-7: scale 1 -> 1.6 -> 0), the link beams, the violet column and the Ousia flame go out, the seam goes dark (temporary groggy look from 8), the whole device tilts 28 degrees in 9 t (5-14), a damped wobble +-8 -> 0 (14-34) while it sinks to the groggy slump at ring centre 3.3 b (14-40).

clips.name: groggy
clips.note: Groggy slump (loop; hittable, no attacks): ring centre 3.3 b, roll 25 and pitch 8 with a slow +-3 wobble, the core sunk under the ring with the arch upright, the eye dim and the seam off (look/groggy), the halo slid and tilted, the pods spinning at a quarter speed, the medallions sunk beside the core, the pendulum swinging +-12 degrees.

clips.name: recover
clips.note: Recovery: re-level and rise (0-6), the core flips to the top (6-15: it rises into the hole while the arch turns 180 degrees over), back in the cruise form. Call look/idle at 0.

clips.name: death
clips.note: Death: the seam flickers hot / off three times (0-16) and goes dark, every spinner stops (14-20), the halo slides off the low side and lands flat on the floor (20-60), the pods drop, the spikes droop, the ring tilts 40 degrees and sinks until its low rim rests on the floor (ring centre 3.0 b; 26-60) with a small bounce (60-67), the pendulum topples over, the medallions clatter down beside the core; everything scales out (80-110). It holds there; call kill after 110.

clips.name: idle_dormant
clips.note: Dormant (form/dormant): folded on the floor at ring centre 2.15 b, still.

clips.name: hold_coreup
clips.note: Core-up rest pose (form/coreup): the gold sphere 2.8 b over the ring, three eyes in a row with their spikes up, roll 10; bob +-0.05.

clips.name: hold_tower
clips.note: Tower rest pose (form/tower); bob +-0.06.

clips.name: hold_laser
clips.note: Laser rest pose (form/laser): the medallions counter-orbit at 5 degrees per tick with their beams (one turn per 72 t).

clips.name: hold_deployed
clips.note: Deployed rest pose (form/deployed): the lances far out; bob +-0.08.

clips.name: break_low
clips.note: 역장 붕괴 on the floor (the 20th hit while the closing wave_drop has the device grounded or low; the module plays it instead of break and calls crack/4 at burst): the bubble flares with the core at the grounded pose (ring centre 2.4 b, the core resting on the floor; 0-5), bursts (5-7: scale 1 -> 1.6 -> 0), the link beams go out and the seam goes dark (temporary groggy look from 8), the pods tuck (4-12) and the device heaves up to 3.1 b while it tilts 21 degrees (5-14), a damped wobble +-4 -> 0 (14-34) while it settles into the groggy slump at ring centre 3.3 b (14-40). Same events and length as break.

bomb.note: a falling bomb: a 0.65 b dark bronze sphere with a gold band and a glowing seam (summon at a port anchor, then tp it down with teleport_duration)

missile.note: a gold drill missile, 1.4 b, point down (-Y in its frame): turn it with its transformation or summon it rotated

objectives.fgRigT: tick within the clip (anchor; -1 = queued by play)
objectives.fgRigForm: stored form: 1 dormant, 2 cruise, 3 field, 4 core-up, 5 tower, 6 laser, 7 deployed
objectives.fgRigLook: stored look: 0 idle, 1 charge, 2 field, 3 groggy, 4 off
objectives.fgRigTmp: 1 while a clip shows a temporary look
